decisions.reason: The same source message already adds the three named articles to this Requirement, and that existing Event fully represents the inclusion impact.
The same source message already establishes that the table of contents is completed only after issue content and pagination are finalized; no additional state change is required.
Adding three articles does not change the existing rule requiring author names and photos for every article; the rule continues to apply unchanged.
The request to include cover-referenced articles for content consistency does not modify the magazine's visual style, branding reference, or color rules.
The editorial addition does not change the requirement to deliver a flipbook-ready digital magazine.
The source does not change the existing conditional requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The source adds issue content but does not alter the digital launch target or deadline.
Adding articles does not modify the established treatment for excessive uninterrupted text or the approved text-break elements.
The editorial placement decision has no effect on flipbook hosting cost or candidate platform choices.
